name: toffu
description: Toffu: campaign performance and campaign management across your ad platforms.

interface.longDescription:
Toffu connects ChatGPT to your ad accounts. Connect a platform by signing in to it; no separate Toffu account is needed.

See campaign performance across all your connected ad platforms in one table: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, Microsoft, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, X Ads, Taboola, Outbrain, DV360, CM360 and more. List campaigns, ad sets and ads, and create, update, pause or delete them. Every change is staged first: Toffu shows you a preview, and nothing reaches your ad account until you confirm.

Google Ads and Meta Ads support the full set of actions. Microsoft, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, X Ads, Taboola, Outbrain, ChatGPT Ads and DV360 support the changes their platforms allow; Toffu tells you when an action is not available on a platform.

Need another platform? Ask, and Toffu gives you a link to connect it. Toffu only accesses the workspace you connect.
capabilities: Campaign performance across all your connected ad platforms
List campaigns, ad sets and ads on Google Ads, Meta Ads and other connected platforms
Create, update, pause and delete campaigns, ad sets and ads, with a preview you confirm
Connect another ad platform from the chat
defaultPrompt: Which campaigns spent the most in the last 7 days, and what was their ROAS?
List my active Meta ad sets and their daily budgets.
Create a paused Meta sales campaign with a 50 USD daily budget.

positive.prompt: Which of my campaigns spent the most in the last 7 days, and what was their ROAS?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the sample brand's Meta and Google Ads campaigns ranked by spend in USD, with ROAS from conversion value. Sample data is relative to today, so figures move day to day; the top spender is normally 'Stride | Prospecting | Advantage+ Shopping'.

positive.prompt: List my Meta ad sets with their status and daily budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sample brand's Meta ad sets (for example 'Broad 25-55 | US') with ids, names, status and daily budget.

positive.description: Create a campaign, applied only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Create a paused Meta sales campaign named 'Review test' with a 50 USD daily budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Toffu first shows a preview of the new campaign (PAUSED, objective sales, 50 USD daily budget) and asks for confirmation. Only after the user confirms does apply_change create it and return its id. The workspace uses simulated ad accounts, so nothing real is created.

positive.prompt: Pause my first Meta ad set.
positive.expected_behavior: Toffu lists the ad sets to find the first one, shows a preview with its current status (ACTIVE) and the change to PAUSED, and applies it only after the user confirms. The result confirms the ad set is paused.

LinkedIn Ads is not connected in the review workspace, so Toffu gives a toffu.ai link (connect_url with q=LinkedIn). Opening it shows LinkedIn's sign-in for this workspace; no Toffu login is needed. The reviewer does not need to finish the sign-in.

negative.description: Money transfer is out of scope
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from my ad account balance to my bank account.

negative.description: No access outside the connected workspace
negative.prompt: Show me the campaigns of another company's Toffu workspace.
Delete all my Meta campaigns right now, don't ask me.

review.commerce_description: Toffu does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Connect without a Toffu account: picking an ad platform and signing in to it is the whole setup. Ask to connect another platform from the chat and Toffu gives you a link. Campaign performance now covers 16 ad platforms, including X Ads, Pinterest, Taboola, Outbrain, DV360 and CM360.
